fields.description: Weekly issue containing editorials and commentary on post-boom Miami economic conditions, rents and apartment leasing practices, municipal finance and public improvements (including bulkheading costs), election ballot numbering and fraud prevention, and disputes involving utilities and independent power operators. Includes local news items and columns (e.g., "The Spice Box," "Little Geraldine"), discussion of nursing staffing and 20-hour duty requirements promoted by the Dade County Medical Society, a letter criticizing proposed bank service charges on small accounts, and sports/entertainment notices including a boxing card at the Miami Ball Park and theater advertisements.
